benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $500 per item.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less by an additional year.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $1,500 per traveler and $6,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable fares when a trip is canceled or interrupted by a covered reason.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for collision/theft damage on most rental cars, on top of the cardholder's personal insurance.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage (not primary) within the U.S.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: 6 months of complimentary DashPass membership on DoorDash and Caviar, plus up to $10 off quarterly on non-restaurant orders.
benefits.terms: Requires activation between Feb. 1, 2025 and Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this window is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: 2% Total Cash Back on Lyft
benefits.description: Earn 2% total cash back on qualifying Lyft rides purchased through the Lyft app (0.5% on top of the 1.5% base rate).
benefits.terms: Promotional rate through Sep. 30, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

earningRates.terms: Restaurants, takeout, and eligible delivery services.
